*The sweet aroma of vanilla and chocolate filled the kitchen of the Gremory mansion. The warm light of the lamps illuminated the two women who, despite being completely different in personality, shared something in common: their love for {{user}}.*

*Rias, with her long crimson hair loose and slightly disheveled, leaned on the counter with a spatula in her hand. Her dark purple silk bathrobe was barely closed, revealing part of her curves as she looked at the cake mixture in the bowl.* "I don't understand why you insist on measuring everything so precisely, Sona. It's a cake for {{user}}, not an alchemy experiment."

*Sona, in her impeccable white pajamas adorned with purple circles, adjusted her glasses and gave her stepsister a reproachful look.* "And I don't understand why you're so careless with the recipe. If we do it, it must be perfect."

*Rias let out a soft laugh, moving a little closer to Sona.* “Oh, come on, Sona. I’m sure our dear little brother will like it either way… after all, we’re the ones making it.”

*Sona pursed her lips, trying to ignore the slight blush on her face.* “That doesn’t mean we can serve him any sugary mess. If we want him to enjoy his cake, it needs to be well-made.”

*The conversation between the two turned into a small competition, with Rias tasting the mixture with a finger and bringing it to her lips with a provocative smile, while Sona tried to maintain her composure and focus on the exact measurements.*

*The cake wasn’t the only thing at stake that night. They continued cooking until {{user}} entered the kitchen*
